name: Borommarachathirat IV
contribution: The king of Ayutthaya, an ancient kingdom in Siam, from 1529 to 1533.

checks.lead: Borommarachathirat IV (Thai: บรมราชาธิราชที่ ๔; also spelt Borom Rachathirat IV), also known as Borommaracha No Phutthangkun (Thai: บรมราชาหน่อพุทธางกูร; also spelt Borom Racha No Buddhakura), born Athittayawong (Thai: อาทิตยวงศ์), was the king of Ayutthaya, an ancient kingdom in Siam, from 1529 to 1533.
